coverage_note: Curated material company, geopolitical and market developments; a starting archive, not an exhaustive news feed. Selection does not establish price causation. No social-media rumor is treated as a completed transaction.
methodology: Use the public report date, not a retrospectively disclosed transaction date. Verified after-close news maps to the next available trading session. Unknown publication timing uses the first session on/after the report date and is explicitly flagged. Returns use the prior close through the 1st, 3rd or 5th session, including the mapped session. Benchmark differences are percentage-point price-return differences, not causal or risk-adjusted abnormal returns. Missing future sessions remain pending.

events.title: IPO priced at $135 a share
events.summary: SpaceX fixed its public offer at $135, with trading scheduled for June 12.
events.channel: Establishes the offer-price reference. The initial trading session has no prior public close for a daily event return.

events.title: SPCX begins public trading
events.summary: June 12 is SpaceX's first public trading day. The $135 offer is separate from the first market purchase price.
events.channel: Price discovery begins; allocation-price returns and first-close returns answer different questions.

events.title: $60B all-stock Cursor acquisition agreed
events.summary: SpaceX agreed to acquire Anysphere, the company behind Cursor, in an all-stock transaction.
events.channel: Adds enterprise software exposure and raises integration and share-dilution questions. Agreement and closing are separate milestones.

events.title: Starship Flight 13 attempt aborts before liftoff
events.summary: An automated last-second abort postponed the Starship test while the company investigated.
events.channel: Development reliability and launch cadence may affect expectations for future Starlink and space revenue.

events.title: Starship test releases advanced Starlink satellites
events.summary: Flight 13 launched and released 20 Starlink satellites. The launch report was published after the US market closed.
events.channel: A technical milestone relevant to future constellation deployment; commercial economics still require execution.

events.title: First public earnings report: Q2 results
events.summary: SpaceX reported $7.8B revenue and a $541M net loss; the release also disclosed Starshield awards and compute contracts.
events.channel: Revenue growth, investment demands and contracts arrived together. A daily move cannot isolate one item in the release.

events.title: Cursor announces acquisition completion
events.summary: Cursor said its acquisition by SpaceX had completed. This entry uses the announcement date rather than backdating the disclosure.
events.channel: Moves the transaction from agreement toward integration and operating results; much of the deal may already have been anticipated.

events.title: Louisiana spaceport investment plan unveiled
events.summary: Reuters reported a proposed $100B Starship launch complex in southern Louisiana. This is a development plan, not completed expenditure.
events.channel: Potential launch capacity comes with financing, permitting and execution exposure.

events.title: First orbital Starship test targeted for September 22
events.summary: SpaceX set a target for an orbital test intended to deploy Starlink V3 satellites. A target date is not evidence that the flight occurred.
events.channel: Updates the expected timing of a technical milestone and the potential capacity expansion.

events.title: Grain agrees to sell nationwide 800 MHz spectrum
events.summary: Grain announced a definitive agreement to sell its nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio to SpaceX, with regulatory approval still required.
events.channel: Supports a terrestrial mobile-network strategy, with additional buildout and approval requirements.

events.title: Reporting links Ukraine Starshield restrictions to US officials
events.summary: Reuters reported limits on Ukraine's Starshield use and conflicting accounts of who ordered them. The public report date drives the marker.
events.channel: Highlights dependence on government customers and decisions, plus political and reputational exposure. Responsibility remained contested.

events.title: Q3 earnings show rapid SI and connectivity growth
events.summary: SpaceX reported $14.6B revenue and $4.4B net income. Its earnings call also brought discussion of a potential Tesla combination.
events.channel: Growth, cash demands and merger discussion overlap in the same observation window; the return cannot be attributed to earnings alone.

events.title: Special committee reviews potential Tesla combination
events.summary: SpaceX disclosed a board committee evaluating a possible combination with Tesla. The review is confirmed; a merger agreement or completion is not.
events.channel: Related-party governance, transaction structure and dilution become relevant. Q3 earnings share this event window.

events.title: US lawmakers question Musk on Ukraine connectivity
events.summary: A congressional letter sought answers about reported Starshield restrictions. The letter confirms scrutiny, not the truth of every allegation it cites.
events.channel: Adds oversight and government-relationship considerations to the national-security business.

events.title: $40B GPU financing announced
events.summary: SpaceX announced GPU financing arrangements with closing conditions and equipment delivery expected in 2027.
events.channel: Could expand compute capacity while increasing long-term financing obligations. Announced financing is distinct from completed deployment.

events.title: Boost Mobile acquisition or network-access talks reported
events.summary: Reuters, citing the Washington Post, reported talks with EchoStar about Boost Mobile or access to its network. No signed deal is established by the report.
events.channel: A possible route into terrestrial wireless distribution, with transaction, carrier-consent and investment uncertainties.

events.title: Qualcomm selected for Starlink terrestrial 5G network
events.summary: Qualcomm announced it will supply cellular infrastructure platforms for Starlink Mobile's planned US terrestrial network, with rollout intended to start in 2027.
events.channel: Adds implementation detail to the wireless strategy, while raising questions about capital spending and deployment economics.

events.title: Post-election reporting focuses on scrutiny of Musk businesses
events.summary: Contemporaneous reporting discussed possible oversight and merger-review implications after the midterm results. These were interpretations of policy risk.
events.channel: Potential changes in oversight can affect expectations, but this reporting does not identify a proven cause of SpaceX's move.

events.title: Broad AI and technology selloff
events.summary: Wall Street saw a broad selloff led by AI and technology shares. Compare SPCX with SPY and QQQ before treating its decline as company-specific.
events.channel: A shared market shock is a competing explanation for a stock move. Benchmark-relative returns are descriptive, not a causal decomposition.
